title: Nine Holes of Thread
subtitle: 纽扣与按钮 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 纽扣与按钮（生活与学习·居家与器物）
meta: 主题语境：纽扣与按钮（生活与学习·居家与器物）　|　核心词汇：button　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 button 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to sew ① a button she could not match, and she said the matching was the whole of the lesson. The ② button, meaning the disc and not the coat, was nine holes wide in the story and was sewn by whoever came last; a button, she said, is the only thing in a drawer that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ button in that drawer had the same thread, and the ④ button at the front, meaning the one the tailor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever sewed properly. A button, my grandmother said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the habit is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ button was the whole of the coat, meaning the garment it held and not the disc. The ⑥ button, meaning the coat and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody loses and nobody questions; a button, he said, is either something you sew or the only word that means both a disc and a coat. She said the coat is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ button had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the thread. The ⑧ button of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine holes and eleven years of sewing; a button, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ button I remember is the one at the front, which was matched in 1968 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ button, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being sewn; every button, she said, is a coat that has agreed to look like a disc. She said the coat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 纽扣（指那枚扣子本身，与外衣相对）
C. 固定搭配：sew a button 缝一枚纽扣
D. n. 纽扣（指抽屉里每一枚）
E. n. 纽扣（指前面那一枚）
F. n. 纽扣（抽象：它扣住的那件外衣）
G. n. 那件外衣（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a button she could not match
The button, meaning the disc and not the coat
button was the whole of the coat
the button had become a photograph in a report
The button of the whole thing
A button, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: sew a button 意为“缝一枚纽扣”，1946 年母亲被派去缝一枚她配不上的纽扣。
button 意为“纽扣”，指那枚扣子本身而不是外衣，故事里有九个孔，由最后走的人缝上。
button 指抽屉里每一枚纽扣，每一枚都是同样的线。
button 指前面那一枚（裁缝留的那一枚），是唯一有人认真缝好的。
button 意为“纽扣”，抽象指它扣住的那件外衣，父亲说 button 就是那件外衣的全部。
button 为抽象用法，指那件外衣本身，是屋子里人人都弄丢、却没人质疑的东西。
button 意为“纽扣、按钮”，到 1963 年这枚 button 成了报告里的一张照片。
button 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个孔和十一年的缝补。
button 意为“纽扣”，我记得的是前面那一枚，1968 年配上，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
button 为抽象总称，祖母说纽扣是唯一会因为被缝回去而变好的东西。
